summary: Aris Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting Q2 2026 earnings. The filing provides financial and operational results, including gold production, revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and cash balance, along with commentary on capital projects at Marmato and Segovia. There is no special-situation transaction or event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC activity. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
